name: Telomere maintenance by telomerase extension and C-strand fill-in
rationale: All members concern telomere maintenance (telomerase recruitment and assembly, telomere packaging, C-strand synthesis), and the telomerase/C-strand fill-in steps separate it from confusables centred on capping, recombination-based maintenance and Cajal-body trafficking.

core: Endosomal TLR7, TLR8 and TLR9 signaling
qualifier: regulation of receptor signaling rather than interferon output
name: Endosomal TLR7, TLR8 and TLR9 signaling regulation
rationale: Every member concerns signaling or regulation of the endosomal nucleic-acid sensing TLR7/8/9 receptors (including SLC15A4:TASL-IRF5 and TLR8-BAFF), whereas confusables centre on type I interferon production, RIG-I/MDA5 or cGAS-STING.

name: Cellular stress responses to ethanol, anesthetics and drugs
rationale: Members are responses to ethanol, ether, anesthetics, antibiotics and drugs plus regulation of oxidative-stress and hypoxia responses, a loose chemical-stress theme distinguished from mitochondrial-respiration confusables by the solvent/anesthetic responses and from other xenobiotic confusables by the stress-response regulation.

name: B cell receptor signaling and its regulation
rationale: All members concern BCR-triggered signaling (second messengers, BTK, RAS), its positive and inhibitory tuning (CD22, activation brakes) and resulting B cell proliferation, separating it from T cell receptor/CD28 and B cell marker-module confusables.

qualifier: phagosomal pathogen nutrient and ion exchange
name: Proton-coupled peptide and phagosomal pathogen nutrient transport
rationale: Members cover proton/oligopeptide and histidine transport across plasma and vacuolar membranes together with host-pathogen ion, iron and heme acquisition at the phagosome, distinguishing it from amino acid transport and systemic iron/heme confusables.

name: Axon regeneration and collateral sprouting regulation
rationale: All members concern regrowth or sprouting of axons and the growth-promoting/inhibiting signals (RHOA, ceramide) controlling it, with collateral sprouting separating it from p75NTR death, myelination and Sema3A repulsion confusables.

name: Tight junction paracellular magnesium transport
rationale: Members combine magnesium transport and homeostasis with tight-junction adhesion and paracellular transport, distinguishing it from sodium/potassium/chloride transport and aquaporin/inositol confusables.

qualifier: chemiosmotic ATP synthesis rather than complex assembly
name: Mitochondrial respiratory electron transport and chemiosmotic ATP synthesis
rationale: All members describe electron flow through complexes III and IV and coupled ATP formation, whereas every confusable concerns assembly of respiratory complexes or mitochondrial translation.

name: Rap1-mediated integrin activation and endothelial shear stress signaling
rationale: Members centre on Rap1-driven integrin activation and integrin-linked MAPK/cytoskeletal signaling in platelets and endothelium, and the PIEZO1 laminar/oscillatory shear-stress responses distinguish it from GPCR platelet, Rho and adhesion confusables.

name: Ubiquitin-proteasome quality control and atypical polyubiquitin linkages
rationale: All members concern ubiquitin-dependent or proteasomal degradation of misfolded proteins (ERAD, N/C-degron rules, proteasome, DUBs), and K6/K11/K27/K29/branched chain formation distinguishes it from autophagy, proteasome-assembly and deubiquitination confusables.

name: Axon guidance by ephrin, netrin and L1-family receptors
rationale: All members concern axon guidance and fasciculation signaling, with ephrin, netrin/DCC, L1/CHL1 and DSCAM pathways separating it from SLIT-ROBO commissural and dendrite self-avoidance confusables.

qualifier: collagen, basement membrane and elastic fibres
name: Collagen, basement membrane and elastic fibre matrix assembly
rationale: Members cover synthesis, crosslinking and organisation of collagen, laminin/basement membrane, fibronectin and elastic fibres plus their integrin and hemidesmosome anchors, distinguishing it from matrix degradation, myogenesis and cornified-envelope confusables.

qualifier: T follicular helper and ICOS co-stimulation
name: B cell activation and differentiation with Tfh/ICOS help
rationale: All members concern B cell proliferation and differentiation including germinal centre fate, and Tfh differentiation and ICOS co-stimulation distinguish it from B cell marker, memory and homeostasis confusables.

qualifier: apoptotic DNA fragmentation and nuclear breakdown
name: Apoptotic execution phase and nuclear DNA fragmentation
rationale: Members concern the execution phase of cell death (DNA fragmentation, chromatin condensation, lamina breakdown, with necroptosis regulation), distinguishing it from mitochondrial/BCL2, p53, death-receptor and RIPK1 initiation confusables.

core: Solute carrier transport of organic metabolites
name: Solute carrier transport of carboxylates, carnitine and metabolic fuels
rationale: All members are carrier-mediated transport of di/tricarboxylates, monocarboxylates, carnitine, glucose and related metabolites (including mitochondrial shuttles and transporter deficiencies), distinguished from organic cation, amino acid and lactate confusables by carnitine and transporter-defect members.

name: FLT3 mutant signaling and tyrosine kinase inhibitor resistance
rationale: Every member concerns FLT3, its oncogenic mutants, their drug resistance or CBL-mediated negative regulation, separating it from KIT, PDGFR, ALK and FGFR mutant confusables.

qualifier: DNA unwinding and polymerase activity in dividing cells
name: Replicative DNA unwinding and polymerase synthesis in dividing cells
rationale: Members concern DNA unwinding, polymerase activity and replication in mitotic division (including break-induced replication), distinguishing it from telomere recombination, DNA repair and replication-initiation confusables.

name: T cell immunological synapse and polarity with CD28-Vav1 signaling
rationale: Members concern immunological synapse assembly, T cell polarity, raft localisation and lymphocyte aggregation, and CD28-Vav1 and Nef signaling distinguish it from CORO1A-DEF6, dendritic cell and homing confusables.

name: Polyamine metabolism and linked methionine salvage
rationale: Members cover polyamine synthesis, oxidation and interconversion together with methionine salvage from methylthioadenosine, which separates it from confusables centred on ODC regulation, polyamine transport and hypusination.

name: Insulin receptor signaling to GLUT4 translocation and glucose uptake
rationale: All members concern insulin action on target cells (IRS/AKT2, receptor recycling, GLUT4 exocytosis, glucose import, glycogen synthesis, glucokinase), distinguishing it from beta-cell insulin secretion and fatty acid oxidation confusables.

name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium handling in skeletal muscle
rationale: Members regulate ryanodine-receptor release, SERCA uptake and membrane calcium flux in striated muscle with skeletal contraction and fibre-type transition, distinguishing it from cardiac contraction and conduction confusables.

name: Epidermal barrier formation and keratinocyte cornification
rationale: All members concern building the skin barrier via cornified envelope assembly and keratinocyte development, distinguishing it from keratinocyte proliferation/differentiation control and epidermal lipid/eicosanoid confusables.

name: Aggrephagy and chaperone-mediated autophagy of misfolded proteins
rationale: Members concern lysosomal disposal of aggregated or misfolded proteins (aggresome, aggrephagy, CMA, microautophagy) and restraint of mitochondrial protein targeting, distinguishing it from ERAD/ubiquitin quality control and stress granule confusables.

name: Osteoblast and osteoclast balance in bone remodeling
rationale: All members regulate osteoblast or osteoclast differentiation, proliferation, fusion or bone resorption, distinguishing it from mineralization, chondrocyte and IGF-response confusables.

name: Methionine cycle, choline and carnitine methyl-group metabolism
rationale: Members cover the methionine/SAM cycle, transsulfuration, methionine salvage, choline catabolism and carnitine synthesis with their inborn errors, distinguishing it from folate, cobalamin and other vitamin metabolism confusables.
